summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The LeaderShares AlphaFactor US Core Equity ETF (LSAF) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the AlphaFactor U.S. Core Equity index. The fund tracks an equal-weighted index of US stocks selected by multiple fundamental factors. LSAF was launched on Oct 2, 2018 and is issued by Redwood.

holdings.infoBox: LSAF is an equity ETF with a total of 102 individual holdings. The top holdings are RingCentral stock at 1.87%, Marathon Petroleum at 1.44%, Valero Energy at 1.39%, Zebra Technologies at 1.35%, and IQVIA Holdings at 1.33%.
